transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I advocate for strict security and privacy measures to protect student attendance data. TRU-01 ensures encryption to safeguard data integrity, while TRU-02 establishes role-based access control to limit access based on user roles, preventing unauthorized access. TRU-03 maintains an audit log for accountability, and TRU-04 ties data visibility to authentication, ensuring only verified users can view records. TRU-05 implements data integrity checks, and TRU-06 provides mechanisms for reporting breaches. Lastly, TRU-07 ensures session management to protect against unauthorized access during inactivity.

transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the importance of ethical and compliance standards in handling student attendance data. RES-05 notifies students of their status, enhancing engagement. RES-06, although overlapping with TRU-02, focuses on ensuring only authorized personnel access sensitive data. requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and implement role-based access control for user access.
The system shall maintain an audit log for all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide timely notifications of attendance status to students within 24 hours.
The system shall ensure accurate attendance tracking through real-time data synchronization.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during data processing.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds for up to 1000 students.
